source.author: stat
source.text: prohibete manus, haec omine dextro moenia Cirrhaea monstravit Apollo iuvenca; pareite, in haec ultro scopuli venere volentes.
source.text_original: 'prohibete manus, haec omine dextro / moenia Cirrhaea monstravit Apollo iuvenca; / pareite, in haec ultro scopuli venere volentes.
source.text_english: Hold back your hands; with this heifer Apollo showed these Cirrhaean walls by a right-hand omen; spare them, for even the rocks have come of their own accord, willingly, to these places.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: non mihi Thessalici pietas culpanda tyranni suspective doli: deus haec, deus omine dextro imperat; ipse suo voluit commercia mundo Iuppiter et tantos hominum miscere labores.
reuse.text_original: non mihi Thessalici pietas culpanda tyranni / suspective doli: deus haec, deus omine dextro / imperat; ipse suo voluit commercia mundo / Iuppiter et tantos hominum miscere labores.
reuse.text_english: I must not blame the piety of the Thessalian tyrant or suspect treachery: God, God with a favorable omen, commands this; Jupiter himself has willed exchanges for his own world and to mingle so great labors of men.
